name: Fujimi Ena
source: Ena is the childhood friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c22679]Chiaki[/url], but she doesn't exactly have the best relationship with him. Being the daughter of a police officer, Ena wants to be a detective, and uses the phrase “これは事件?!” (Is this a case?!) rather frequently, with the similar background to the popular series, Detective Conan. As it turns out, Ena doesn’t recognize Chiaki’s crossdressing and ends up believing he is actually Chiaki’s cousin.
translation: 绘奈是[url=https://vndb.org/c22679]千秋[/url]的青梅竹马，但两人的关系并不算好。由于父亲是警察，她想成为侦探，经常说“これは事件?!（这是案件？！）”，背景与人气系列《名侦探柯南》相似。结果，她没有认出女装的千秋，反而相信对方是千秋的表亲。
